introHtml: Independent Trading Co is known for its heavyweight, streetwear-inspired blanks that hold up to frequent washing and heavy use. For bulk buyers, this means your logo or design stays sharp on hoodies, crewnecks, and jackets that recipients actually want to wear. Whether you are outfitting a warehouse crew or launching a limited-edition company drop, these garments offer a premium canvas for screen printing, embroidery, or heat transfer. Choose from a range of earth tones and classic neutrals that align with modern uniform aesthetics.
